items.text: Explosive ammo now deals damage to monument blockers.
Crates and barrels on oil rigs now respawn as intended.
Siege tower doors work correctly and NPCs no longer get stuck when doors slam.

2026-08-29.summary:
### Combat & Weapons
- Explosive ammo now deals damage to monument blockers.

### World & Resources
- Crates and barrels on oil rigs now respawn as intended.

### NPC & AI
- Siege tower doors work correctly and NPCs no longer get stuck when doors slam.

### Performance
- Satellite debris and dish now use optimized LOD and occlusion, cutting draw calls dramatically and reducing FPS spikes.

### Bug Fixes
- Deployable objects now retain their correct skins, eliminating random skin swaps.
- Heavy plate footstep sound no longer produces a high‑frequency metal clink, reducing audio annoyance.

items.text: Fixed hull placement, boat creation, and deployable height limits when building boats, preventing errors from assuming ocean level is zero.
Added a new sea turtle rig, introducing sea turtles into the world.
Resolved black player eye rendering issue in Bandit Camp environments.
Store icons now correctly refresh when reopening the store via the escape menu, preventing missing or outdated icons.

2026-08-28.summary:
### Boats & Watercraft
- Fixed hull placement, boat creation, and deployable height limits when building boats, preventing errors from assuming ocean level is zero.

### Animals
- Added a new sea turtle rig, introducing sea turtles into the world.

### Graphics Bugs
- Resolved black player eye rendering issue in Bandit Camp environments.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Store icons now correctly refresh when reopening the store via the escape menu, preventing missing or outdated icons.

items.text: Fixed master key animation so it no longer gets stuck when left‑clicked.
Code locks with two or fewer authorized users are excluded from door tax calculations, reducing upkeep for small player‑run hotels.
Boat building stations now deploy correctly regardless of ocean level.
Structure and pipe placement now retries with relaxed anchor checks, greatly reducing failed builds.
Industrial crafter retains its processing state after a power loss, eliminating manual restarts.
Unpowered water pumps no longer act as gravity sources.
Network update range for critters reduced, limiting how far they can be seen and interacted with.
Disabled client‑side prediction for firecrackers and survey charges to stop erratic behavior.
Crystal AR now spawns with its starting ammunition.
HAB armor now correctly reports its own health instead of the parent balloon's health.
Paintable dialogs (painting, pumpkin, sculpture, neon) now work while the F1 menu is open and brush preview no longer hides the cursor.
Gamepad cursor speed is reduced when moving UI sliders or holding the left trigger, with snapping and configurable speeds.

2026-08-27.summary:
### Tools & Locks
- Fixed master key animation so it no longer gets stuck when left‑clicked.
- Code locks with two or fewer authorized users are excluded from door tax calculations, reducing upkeep for small player‑run hotels.

### Building & Environment
- Boat building stations now deploy correctly regardless of ocean level.
- Structure and pipe placement now retries with relaxed anchor checks, greatly reducing failed builds.
- Industrial crafter retains its processing state after a power loss, eliminating manual restarts.

### World Systems
- Unpowered water pumps no longer act as gravity sources.
- Network update range for critters reduced, limiting how far they can be seen and interacted with.

### Combat
- Disabled client‑side prediction for firecrackers and survey charges to stop erratic behavior.
- Crystal AR now spawns with its starting ammunition.
- HAB armor now correctly reports its own health instead of the parent balloon's health.

### User Interface
- Paintable dialogs (painting, pumpkin, sculpture, neon) now work while the F1 menu is open and brush preview no longer hides the cursor.
- Gamepad cursor speed is reduced when moving UI sliders or holding the left trigger, with snapping and configurable speeds.
